units.source_text: 且说源氏公子走进他所指望的邸内，

en.t: Now Prince Genji entered the residence he had been hoping to visit,

units.source_text: 果然不出所料：人影寥寥，庭阶寂寂，这光景教人看了十分可怜。

en.t: and it was just as he had expected: there were few people about, the garden steps were silent, and the whole scene looked deeply forlorn.

units.source_text: 他先去访问丽景殿女御，和她谈谈当年种种旧事，不觉夜色已阑。

en.t: He first went to visit the Lady Reikeiden and spoke with her about many things from former days, until before he knew it the night had grown late.

units.source_text: 二十日的缺月升入空中，庭前高大的树木暗影沉沉，附近的橘子树飘送可爱的香气来。

en.t: The waning moon of the twentieth day rose into the sky, the tall trees before the garden cast deep shadows, and a nearby mandarin orange tree sent over a lovely fragrance.

units.source_text: 女御虽然上了年纪，但仪态端庄，容貌昳丽。

en.t: Although the lady had grown older, her bearing was dignified and her face was still beautiful.

units.source_text: 虽然不复有桐壶院的宠幸，其人还是亲切可爱。

en.t: Though she no longer enjoyed the favor of the Kiritsubo Emperor, she herself remained warm and charming.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回思往事，当年情状历历在目，不禁流下泪来。

en.t: As Prince Genji thought back on the past, the scenes of those days came vividly before his eyes, and he could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 此时杜鹃又叫起来，大约就是适才篱垣边的那只鸟吧，鸣声全然相同。

en.t: Just then a cuckoo began to call again; it was probably the same bird that had been by the fence earlier, for its voice was exactly the same.

units.source_text: 此鸟逐人而来，源氏公子觉得极有风趣，便低声吟诵古歌：

en.t: Feeling that the bird had followed him there and finding it full of poetic charm, Prince Genji softly recited an old poem:

units.source_text: “候鸟也知人忆昔，啼时故作昔年声。”又吟诗道：

en.t: “Even the migrant bird knows that people remember the past, and when it cries, it deliberately uses the voice of former years.” Then he recited another poem:
